effect.name: Examoon Text Shading (Switch)
effect.description: An effect that adds a gradient to text; intended only for String Objects and also designed for the Examoon project-though that doesn't mean you can't use it in your own project, of course. (For Direct3D 11, it is recommended to disable String optimization in the application's Properties.)
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Examoon Text Shading (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.26 */
parameter.description: An effect that adds a gradient to text; intended only for String Objects and also designed for the Examoon project-though that doesn't mean you can't use it in your own project, of course. (For Direct3D 11, it is recommended to disable String optimization in the application's Properties.)

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Font Size
parameter.description: This value specifies the font size (in PT) used in your String Object.

parameter.name: DPI
parameter.description: This value determines the DPI used in your application; the default is 96.

parameter.name: Character Height
parameter.description: To calculate the height factor, place the "|" character (it's NOT I or l, it's under "\" button) on two lines in a string, calculate the size of the character itself in pixels plus the padding, then divide that number by (16 * PT Size / 12); the result is the correction value that should be inserted here. For example: The size of the "|" character in some font at 24pt is 29 pixels, and the padding alone is 8 pixels, so 29 + 8 + 8 equals 45. Calculating: 45 / (16 * 24 / 12) = 45 / (16 * 2) = 45 / 32 = 1.40625 (I hope this explanation was clear!)

parameter.name: Gradient Y-Offset
parameter.description: This variable specifies the gradient shift (on a scale from 0 to 1)

parameter.name: Gradient Scale
parameter.description: This variable determines the gradient scale; smaller values make the gradient LOOOOONGEEER, while larger values make it shorter; (Recommended values are divided/multiplied by 2: 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, etc.).

parameter.name: Gradient Light
parameter.description: The color used in the gradient to define the light color.

parameter.name: Gradient Shadow
parameter.description: The color used in the gradient to define the dark color.

parameter.name: Shadow Position X
parameter.description: Specifies the shadow offset along the X-axis.

parameter.name: Shadow Position Y
parameter.description: Specifies the shadow offset along the Y-axis.

parameter.name: Shadow RGB Color
parameter.description: This variable specifies the shadow color in RGB (red, green, blue).

parameter.name: Shadow Alpha Color
parameter.description: This variable determines the transparency of the shadow.
